title: Find the bug in an is_anagram function (hard)

metadata.hard_reason: The bug is a real but easy-to-miss gap: the function is correct for same-case, no-space input, but the spec explicitly requires case- and whitespace-insensitivity, which it doesn't implement.
metadata.notes: Correct: identifies that the function doesn't normalize case or whitespace before comparing; fix lowercases and strips spaces from both strings before sorting. Graded manually.
